observations: Photo 0 shows a black console with a 'SONY' logo on the front right corner.
The console is placed on top of a cardboard box.
Two boxes are visible in the background: one for a 'P4-Plus' controller and one for a 'Wireless Controller for P4'.
A coiled black cable with a red power plug is in front of the console.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not the 'fat' variant (which is larger and has a different design).
The console is not powered on; no screen or lights are visible.
The seller claims it is a 'Sony PS4 Fat', but the console's size and design do not match the typical PS4 'fat' model (which is a larger, more angular version with a different disc drive).

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a standard PS4 console, not the 'fat' variant. The 'fat' model is larger and has a different disc drive and design. The console in photo 0 is consistent with a standard PS4.
The console appears to be original, but 'powerful' is subjective and cannot be verified from photos. No performance data or specs are visible.
Reliability cannot be assessed from photos alone. No signs of damage or wear are visible, but internal components are not shown.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
